scope: Every table and outer figure in the submitted preprint input graph, plus explicit non-tabulated result/method anchors. Source enumeration is mechanical; interpretation, evidence mapping and dependency assessments are authored. Rows overlap and are not a completion-percentage denominator. This audit executes no Lean, models or GPUs. It binds selected already published evidence, including complete independent native weighted RMSNorm and online-attention studies at experiment-code commit 3401f08. It changes no original result to reproduced and freezes its evidence for replay without a historical checkout.

floats.label: tab:trust
floats.title: Acceptance basis and trust boundary
floats.available_evidence: Fixed source/reference statements, actual launch/RF theorems, standard-axiom audits, isolated rechecks and a pinned exact-real interpretation are implemented. Floating-point cancellation probes demonstrate the limit of interpreting real equality as IEEE equivalence. The independent native RMSNorm exports bind all 70 proof modules, closed source/reference/task statements and optional dependency pins; installed-wheel and standalone rebuild checks pass. Hardware correspondence and IEEE error bounds remain outside the proof. The native online-attention packets freshly rebuild 84 scalar modules and 91 modules with canonical-real semantics, audit 174 and 17 results, and reject 29 and four scoped false claims. Independent archive replays repeat these checks. Canonical-real casts are identities only in that interpretation; IEEE equivalence and floating-point error bounds are unproved.
floats.assessment: independent restricted implementation; broader coverage remains

narrative.title: Original Lean-to-Torch specification tests
narrative.available_evidence: Independent reference/AST checks include retained intermediate SiLU half rounding and a canonical-real sum. Wave-study numerical comparisons execute CPU Torch; serial FP32 reference-AST evaluation differs bitwise in 3,840 outputs. No IEEE theorem or original metaprogram-test reproduction is claimed. The new native RMSNorm profile joins actual launch correctness to a canonical-real weighted reference. This does not recover the authors' specification tests. Native online attention now connects the actual source launch to an independent dense 128-key/256-component real SDPA reference and proves positive online denominators. Separate both-host numerical audits perform 3,145,728 CPU-double comparisons with zero tolerance failures, retaining 260,402/786,432 FP16-versus-rounded-FP32 bit differences per host. This finite evidence is not an IEEE theorem or the original specification test.
narrative.assessment: independent analogue only; original result not reproduced

narrative.title: Production adaptations, departures and llm.c race/repair
narrative.available_evidence: A pinned independent scalar vLLM SiLU adaptation has source-bound native multiwave proofs and extracted-upstream comparisons. This is one family, with its source-half rounding retained. Original adapted files/revisions/departures and the full llm.c repair proof remain unavailable. The additional native weighted RMSNorm study proves the actual whole launch and canonical-real outputs, with both-host numerical validation. Its source departures are recorded independently and do not recreate the authors' rewrites. A third independent upstream-derived native family, FP16 online attention, has whole-launch/actual-trace proofs and dense-real correctness at its fixed profile, with four source-bound exports. Its source is identical to the previously GPU-tested adaptation. No original adapted source, production run or departure history is recovered.
narrative.assessment: independent analogue only; original result not reproduced

narrative.title: Signature-derived premises, extraction and non-vacuity
narrative.available_evidence: Actual native scalar launches include partial final waves, and one full wave64 reduction has complete execution/RF proofs under its fixed disjoint-buffer interface. Original in-place, stride, packed/vector and general signature coverage is incomplete. The native RMSNorm proof quantifies over all inputs/outside memory and all 1<=rows<256 at the fixed native shape; host alignment and disjointness remain explicit assumptions. The native attention theorem quantifies over all scalar operations, inputs and initial outside memory for every allowed group count 1..65535; the canonical-real specialization additionally proves dense SDPA equality and positive denominators. Disjoint-buffer/profile assumptions remain explicit.
narrative.assessment: independent restricted implementation; broader coverage remains

narrative.title: Named refusal boundary and exact-operation idealizations
narrative.available_evidence: Restricted profiles refuse more forms than the paper. Real sum equality is proved for one closed program; finite cancellation disagreements explicitly prevent a floating-point-equivalence claim. Broader operations and original refusal outcomes remain unverified. Complete aligned logical-16 cohorts within physical wave64 and a complete native RMSNorm reduction are now supported. Arbitrary sparse masks, other optimized kernels and IEEE error theorems remain unsupported. The fixed native attention development profile now has a complete four-key-tile/nine-phase proof and canonical-real exports. Ordinary-reader bounds and memory restrictions remain; packed/vector, arbitrary sparse subgroups and generalized optimized-kernel support remain software work.
narrative.assessment: independent restricted implementation; broader coverage remains

narrative.title: Race-freedom obligations and scheduling assumption
narrative.available_evidence: Per-program obligations are Lean checked; the scheduling reduction remains a declared trusted passage, not a proved hardware scheduler theorem. The complete native RMSNorm proof classifies every actual input, shared partial/scale and output access through both block epochs and derives race freedom. The native attention proof also derives race freedom from the complete actual runLaunch trace across all nine phases and all blocks, rather than assuming trace classification or a successful finite preflight. Hardware scheduler correspondence remains outside this proof.
narrative.assessment: independent restricted implementation; broader coverage remains

narrative.available_evidence: Source/signature binding and trusted inputs are reported independently; the original generator/hint interface is unavailable.
narrative.assessment: independent restricted implementation; broader coverage remains

dependencies.registry: Authors' original task/language registry: exact kernel bytes, signatures, launches, reference modules, pinned operation tables, and exported proofs. Independent programs at equal shapes cannot replace these inputs.
dependencies.harness: Original proof-agent harness and prompts, segmentation/scaffolding, tool protocol, retries, stopping rules, context compaction, model settings and usage accounting.
dependencies.runs: Original request/response and checker traces, model revisions and original hosted-model outcomes. Offline/free inference does not recover historical paid or closed-model runs.
dependencies.mutants: All 42 original mutant source files, baseline bindings, rule assignments, final-run traces and rejection-channel decisions, including independent second opinions.
dependencies.production: The ten exact adapted production sources, upstream commits, ordered rewrites/departures, argument signatures and launch metadata; nine accepted full-kernel proof projects and the rejected kernel trace.
dependencies.hardware: Original optimized kernels and numerical contracts, complete fastest-vendor baselines, H100 execution for PTX/CUDA and same-device MI300X HIP measurements. MI350X measurements cannot fill H100 cells.
dependencies.semantics: Broader readers and scalable packed/vector, combined multi-warp collective and arbitrary sparse-subgroup proofs remain software work. Complete independent native multiwave activation, weighted RMSNorm and fixed-shape online-attention launches, aligned logical-16 cohorts inside physical wave64, single-shape MFMA and exact-real wave-sum profiles do not cover the original optimized registry. The native attention source uses a separately scoped development reader and source-bound export checker; its proof does not broaden the ordinary reader automatically.
dependencies.history: Authors' source tree and development records. An independent implementation cannot recreate historical person-days, original source-line totals or original code-sharing percentages.
dependencies.gqa_export: Authors' supplementary standalone GQA proof project and its pinned toolchain/dependencies; it was not present in the inspected manuscript archive or bounded release endpoints.
dependencies.specification: Authors' elaborated Lean module formalizations, metaprogram/reference tests, accepted shape/precision contracts and associated trusted-assumption reports.
